4881-6909-7223-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7223-8199.easyPrerequisites: Stalactite Dagger is attached to Carnage.
4881-6909-7223-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
3899-5254-8122.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3899-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

728-3249-5004-6723.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5004-6723.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

240-4885-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=1 that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

4050-4153-5660--35.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=1 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or {1} available otherwise.
4050-4153-5660--35.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying one mana, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-6633-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-7804.notablePrerequisites:
You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
The top card of your library is a nonland card.
1245-1475-7804.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirit token(s) enter, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers that many times, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
When the Carnivore token enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Carnivore token
Repeat.

1479-5362-5621.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5359-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-4350-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
4050-4350-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

140-3245-6735.description:
Activate Soul Channeling by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

2981-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
2981-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

423-1437-1671-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-1671-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-1671-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

423-1257-1437-3861--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1257-1437-3861--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

454-1978-7203.description:
Cause Brigid to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures 
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brigid.
Repeat from step 2.

112-2104-6496.manaNeeded: {9}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-2104-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-2104-6496.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation and exiling the original Temporal Manipulation with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Temporal Manipulation and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Temporal Manipulation and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-2104-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Temporal Manipulation is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Temporal Manipulation is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

5256-6754-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2392-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6669-7063.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Ember Island Production twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Ember Island Productions, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3532-4985-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4985-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4740-5220-6798-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
4740-5220-6798-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4740-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

1003-3698-5220-6900.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

789-2399-2921--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-2921--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on it each time.
Repeat.
789-2399-2921--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

439-4766-5683-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1548-3719-5686-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-3719-5686-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1287-1308-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-1308-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create two token copies of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2724-3080-3963-4608.notablePrerequisites:
Meneldor does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-3963-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor, triggering its ability, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

1365-2034-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2034-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher, adding {C}{C}.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

877-2034-3001.description:
Cast Mortus Strider by paying {1} due to Morophon.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mortus Strider, adding {C}{C}.
When Mortus Strider dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2757-3182-5014.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You control at least one basic Forest.
1270-2757-3182-5014.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a land card.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Plant, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1780-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Burdened Aerialist.
When Burdened Aerialist enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Burdened Aerialist that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Burdened Aerialist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3946-4935-5447.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

140-3887-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-3887-5195.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to Rowan's ability.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

2464-3995-4944.notablePrerequisites:
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters on it.
2464-3995-4944.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Horseshoe Crab ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-5144.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Ephemerate.
147-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Ephemerate, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ephemerate, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-4591-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion etners the battlefield, dealing you and target creature an arbitrarily large amount of damage, with you not losing the game due to Platinum Angel.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the amount of damage dealt this way.

2420-5147-5150.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2420-5147-5150.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders.
Scuzzback Marauders dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Bramblewood Paragon.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
